name: Surge to Victory
oracle_text: Exile target instant or sorcery card from your graveyard. Creatures you control get +X/+0 until end of turn, where X is that card's mana value. Whenever a creature you control deals combat damage to a player this turn, copy the exiled card. You may cast the copy without paying its mana cost.
blocked_sentences: Exile target instant or sorcery card from your graveyard.

needs.what: a verification-sandbox prop: an instant or sorcery card in player 0's graveyard, swapped in (like swap_in_legendary_body / swap_in_artifact_body) only for a card whose required card_in_graveyard target selects Instant or Sorcery, so a mandatory 'target instant or sorcery card from your graveyard' spell is castable at gate 4
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The DSL already says the whole card: a card_in_graveyard target (any_types Instant/Sorcery, controller you), exile as 'banked', pump of creatures you control with power {mana_value_of: {binding: banked}}, and a this_turn delayed_trigger on deals_combat_damage_to_player (controller you) whose effect is cast_copy {objects: {binding: banked}, optional: true}. It passes schema, compile and residual, then fails gate 4 'not playable in the sandbox' because OWN_GRAVEYARD_ROLES is (small_creature, flier) and no instant or sorcery card is ever in the graveyard, so a required target has no legal choice (601.2c). Marking the target optional (as mizzix_s_mastery does) would describe a different card. With OWN_GRAVEYARD_ROLES patched in memory to include noncreature_spell (Anticipate, MV 2) the same answer passes gate 4 and resolves with graveyard_size {0: 2}.

spell_effects.text: Whenever a creature you control deals combat damage to a player this turn, copy the exiled card. You may cast the copy without paying its mana cost.
